images.filename: Proposed Map of C and O Canal.jpg
images.caption: Proposed Map of Chesapeake and Ohio Canal, including portions never built. The line follows Wills Creek north from Cumberland to Hyndman PA, continues north up Little Wills Creek north and west. It crosses the Eastern Divide, follows Buffalo Creek (just south of Berlin PA) to Garret PA on the Casselman River. It then follows the Casselman river to the Youghiogheny River at Confluence, PA, then to Connellsville PA.
images.alt: Proposed Map of Chesapeake and Ohio Canal, including portions never built. The line follows Wills Creek north from Cumberland to Hyndman PA, continues north up Little Wills Creek north and west. It crosses the Eastern Divide, follows Buffalo Creek (just south of Berlin PA) to Garret PA on the Casselman River. It then follows the Casselman river to the Youghiogheny River at Confluence, PA, then to Connellsville PA.

images.caption:
Oblique air photo of Cumberland Narrows (a water gap), facing northeast, December 10, 2006.
Wills Mountain is at top, Haystack Mountain (Maryland) is at bottom.
The anticlinal structure of the Tuscarora Formation (sandstone layer at top and sides of the mountain) is apparent in this photo.
w:U.S. Route 40 Alternate and the National Road & historic Cumberland Road runs through the pass from and above w:Cumberland, Maryland, as did the historic Baltimore and Ohio Railroad's tracks to the Monongahela Valley in Pennsylvania passing through the Cumberland Narrows pass above Cumberland, Maryland. The Western Maryland Railroad also ran track through the gap.
images.alt:
Oblique air photo of Cumberland Narrows (a water gap), facing northeast, December 10, 2006.
Wills Mountain is at top, Haystack Mountain (Maryland) is at bottom.
The anticlinal structure of the Tuscarora Formation (sandstone layer at top and sides of the mountain) is apparent in this photo.
w:U.S. Route 40 Alternate and the National Road & historic Cumberland Road runs through the pass from and above w:Cumberland, Maryland, as did the historic Baltimore and Ohio Railroad's tracks to the Monongahela Valley in Pennsylvania passing through the Cumberland Narrows pass above Cumberland, Maryland.
